tasks.label: Android: Run on Emulator (Dance4Life)
tasks.command: cd Dance4Life/AndroidSensor && bash ./gradlew assembleDebug && EMULATOR=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/emulator/emulator && LAUNCHER=../../.vscode/start_emulator_detached.py && AVD_NAME=${D4L_AVD:-dance4life_api35} && PHONE_SERIAL=emulator-5554 && if [ -z "$AVD_NAME" ]; then echo 'No phone AVD found. Set D4L_AVD or create dance4life_api35.'; exit 1; fi && adb start-server && if ! adb -s "$PHONE_SERIAL" get-state >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$LAUNCHER" "$EMULATOR" /tmp/dance4life-emulator.log -avd "$AVD_NAME" -port 5554 -netdelay none -netspeed full; fi && adb -s "$PHONE_SERIAL" wait-for-device && until [ "$(adb -s "$PHONE_SERIAL" shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do echo 'Waiting for phone emulator boot...'; sleep 2; done && adb -s "$PHONE_SERIAL" reverse tcp:5000 tcp:5000 && adb -s "$PHONE_SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb -s "$PHONE_SERIAL" shell am start -n com.example.dance4life_phone/.ui.MainActivity
